draft.emotion: a sense of wonder at something grand, vast, and permanent
notes: Counted with the classifier ลูก (lûuk). In everyday speech it is often shortened to เขา (khǎo).
Covers both mountains and large hills; for a small gentle hill, use เนินเขา (nəən-khǎo).
